programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: Rick tries out a new recipe - pork chops with a sloe berry sauce, before heading to the village of Rock, where his son, Jack, holds a clam bake on the shore of the Camel Estuary.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: The town of Launceston is bypassed by many who visit Cornwall, yet Rick discovers it's home to an unusual superstition. Rick rounds off his trip cooking an alfresco dish of Cornish mussels with cider.

programs.title: Getting Grilled With Curtis Stone
programs.desc: Teri Hatcher is in the hot seat, and she is not afraid of the fire! The actress proves she's an open book, spilling stories and details you haven't heard before about her childhood.

programs.title: Ainsley's Great Garden Cook Off
programs.desc: Ainsley is joined by chefs Ben Ebbrell and Cyrus Todiwala in the kitchen garden of Blicking Hall in Norfolk for a light-hearted cooking contest.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam Liaw explores the amazing and unique culinary culture of Japan. This week, Adam uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.
